name: labs/pymodaq__pymodaq_plugins_smaract
title: SmarAct MCS2 controller channel (pymodaq_plugins_smaract)
intro: SmarAct MCS2 controller channel (pymodaq_plugins_smaract), adapted from pymodaq/pymodaq_plugins_smaract. It reads `position`, `units`, `base_resolution`, `positioner_type` and 3 more; runs `absolute_move`, `relative_move`, `find_reference` and `stop_motion`. `absolute_move`: move the bound MCS2 channel to an absolute position given in controller base units. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
